Module io.github.jpersist.tools.hibernate.base
Package hibernate.base.persistence.tools

Class HibernateUtil

java.lang.Object
hibernate.base.persistence.tools.HibernateUtil
public class HibernateUtil extends Object
Utility class for Hibernate-related operations.

This class provides shared helper methods for working with Hibernate persistence tools, including converting configuration settings maps to strongly-typed enhancer options, converting filesystem references to URLs, and constructing isolated class loaders for inspection of compiled entity classes.

1.0.0

  • Method Details

    • convertSettings

      public static Map<HibernateEnhancerOption,Boolean> convertSettings(Map<String,Object> settings)
      Converts a Map of string-keyed settings to a Map of HibernateEnhancerOption to boolean values.

      The keys of the returned map are the HibernateEnhancerOption instances corresponding to the string keys of the input map, resolved via HibernateEnhancerOption.from(String). The values of the returned map are the boolean values of the input map.

      Parameters:
      settings - the settings map to convert, where keys represent property key strings and values are booleans
      Returns:
      the converted settings map mapping each HibernateEnhancerOption to its boolean state
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any key in settings does not match a known HibernateEnhancerOption
      ClassCastException - if any value in settings cannot be cast to Boolean

      Parameters:
